source_snapshot.items: Out-of-band firmware upgrade/downgrade and recovery for GPU
source_snapshot.procedure: Redfish upload bundle to HGX_0, wait task and check inventory.

old_problem: GPU mapping, direction/current-target versions, signed image and OOB recovery are unbound.
disposition_reason: The OOB GPU firmware lifecycle is identifiable; ED-03 permits UUID/BDF, direction, image and version matrix as mandatory runtime configuration. ED-07/12 keep each upgrade or downgrade execution separately authorized.
decision_basis: Preserved OOB flash, version and recovery coverage; split directions at execution.
No upload, flash or cycle occurred.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized OOB GPU firmware upgrade or downgrade
test_case.purpose: Perform one approved direction on mapped GPUs through the advertised OOB update service and verify active versions plus recovery readiness.
test_case.test_command: Bind one direction; capture inventory; verify image/targets; submit one authorized task; preserve status; perform approved activation; verify every target version and GPU/link/platform health.
test_case.expected_result: Only mapped GPUs reach exact target versions and remain healthy after activation.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Upgrade and downgrade require separate evidence; task completion alone is insufficient.
test_case.recovery: Stop on task/version/health failure and invoke the signed direction-specific rollback/OOB procedure.

source_conflict.reason: Generic HGX_0 is explicitly bound at runtime to a signed GPU map and one direction.
